notes.title: Announcing Trials Of The Hollowed update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone thanks for being patient with me while working on this update I know I have been quiet with announcements until today, if you ever want to keep informed with what I am working on you can join the Discord: https://discord.gg/nFMeNE3TTY or follow the Twitter: https://twitter.com/PlayFarGone

Today I can finally announce whats coming in the next few days to Fargone! Trials Of The Hollowed features a variety of new mechanics, items, locations and much more. The raw patch notes are listed at the bottom of this post however I would like to showcase some of the bigger changes in better detail.

A quick note on existing saves. 

From testing a new character will not be required, that being said this update focuses a lot on re balance to create a more rewarding progression path so to make the most from the update I would recommend a new character. To add to this being that the game is in Alpha, should you encounter any bugs on an existing save please let me know.

[h2]The Arena is now open![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/37a070e04697d257bdd078d4c5edffe29ac8896d.png[/img]

Players can now head down to the Arena to pay a small fee and enter. The Arena comes with 10 waves where you must defend a building along with other participants. Rewards are based on the amount survived and your items are safe from being lost on death. The Arena is ran by the Hollowed meaning players will earn reputation as well as XP and money from participating. The Arena is also a good place to try and obtain the new weapons for surviving into the higher rounds!

[h2]New enemies & Hunting[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/202ab1870d999171dd314330dabd0f060fbfc98c.png[/img]

New types of enemies can be found across the Barrens ranging from undead dogs to husks infected with a new type of disease causing them to be covered in glowing growths that will explode if shot or when the husk is near its target. Deer will now also populate the world allowing the players to gather important resources. Hunting will require a skinning knife. 

[h2]New quests[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/9394a514d7dad51b6db6a190b9d28f405ce67d2b.png[/img]

While this updates primary focus is not on quests there are several new ones for you to complete including a new repeatable bounty board that refreshes every day with new tasks allowing the player to gain XP, money, faction reputation and some items. As well as this a new prequel quest line has been added that helps setup the first full narrative quest line that will be coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/93d43d641ab79623d3c2638f1f47af3a246c5855.png[/img]

[h2]New locations & World events[/h2]

The Barrens has received several new locations across the world! How the inhabitants never noticed the giant factory sat in the middle of the world is unknown, maybe it was the fog or just apocalyptic mystery either way you will find a variety of new locations to explore during your travels all of which is now being custom modelled for Fargone specifically! Additionally new bandit camps are now dotted around the map providing loot for those who want to charge into conflict. Human and undead AI have also received new spawns allowing for a greater variety of conflicts around the map.

The first version of world events has also been implemented, original I was not going to release this feature yet as the reward system is not complete however seeing the new world events happening across the map was so much fun that for now I decided to leave it in just for the world building aspect. This will be further expanded in a minor patch between now and the next major update but for now you can come across several random scenarios that better shows the conflict enveloping The Barrens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/f54772d03a05c7668fb6b590980afcd87d07966c.png[/img]

[h2]Re animated weapons & New weapons[/h2]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/nDTlMZhv3xk9qrekZk/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611b5367aa1421192abfe25ca07532b1d7db5fd8eee&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[h2]Expanded survival & Difficulty Re-balance[/h2]

Watching people play the game has shown that the in game economy was quite easy and people were getting geared up and unstoppable within an hour. One of the big focuses of this update is new survival options and re working the out of combat difficulty to create a better sense of reward and progression. The first major addition is weapon jamming. Weapons will now become unstable at lower conditions requiring the user to manually unjam the weapon (or reload if the weapon does not currently contain the new animation rework). Additionally larger weapon repair kits will now be required to repair weapons that fall too low with their condition. Weapons found in the world and on AI will now spawn with lower conditions to better show the harsh nature of The Barrens and to remove the idea that everyone is running around with pristine weapons straight out the factory. You may still loot a good gun early on but find it jams so much it's not feasible to use yet requiring you to scavenge for a way to repair it. Additionally shops will pay far less for warn and used items including weapons.

Expanded gear maintenance. Your armour, helmet and masks all can become damaged from use and will require the use of new armour repair kits and gas mask filters to repair. Gas masks in particular will now become worn out with prolonged use in hazardous areas requiring you to change the filter with a slick new animation! The armour repair system also ties directly into the hunting system allowing players to hunt for certain resource required to craft these new repair kits.

[h2]Much much more...[/h2]

This is a quick summary of some big points however the patch notes below contain all the changes coming to the game. The update is scheduled to release this Friday with the game also going on sale to celebrate the first big update launch. I hope everyone enjoys the update and as always feel free to reach out with any suggestions or bugs! As always a massive thank you to everyone who has played the game!

notes.title: Announcing Fargone!
notes.content:
Hi there!

This day has been a long time coming for me and I am very excited to finally show off Fargone.

With the release date approaching fast, I wanted to take this time to discuss where the game is currently at, future updates, and the overall long-term vision for the game.

Discord: https://discord.gg/BYWHzGa4JK

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/068140f13beec169825c93aa6c52a1fd6f50b66e.png[/img]

[h1]What to expect on December 23rd[/h1]

Currently, the game has a large open world filled with unique locations and biomes that hide 100's of items to scavenge. The world is also populated by multiple factions as well as a variety of undead types. The idea was to create a dynamic sandbox experience as the core gameplay loop. You can work with the factions, completing missions or assisting them in any engagements you may encounter. You can even take their badges and hand them in for a reputation boost with the other factions. 
Fargone also features a camping/building system. I have called it the camping system, as currently the idea was not for the player to build an immense fortress of safety but simply to create just enough of a safe area to be able to rest and store gear. This system can also be used to fortify existing locations around the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/6372f60e27e5c03fbde75f92fcf19adf7033beb4.png[/img]

[h2]Weapons & Equipment[/h2]
In terms of weapons, the exact count is still growing right up until release. As it stands there are 23 weapons in the game including guns, melee weapons, and grenades (grenades do not add to the total weapon count). These weapons are hard to come by out in the world; however, there are numerous stores located around the map that refresh every 2 days in the game. Most of these weapons have a selection of customisation options to allow the player to tune a weapon to a specific engagement; like putting a long-range scope on an AK. To add to this, there are several unique/legendary weapons in the game that are extremely rare, so keep an eye out! Guns specifically also need to be maintained to function properly, done by acquiring a variety of cleaning items.
You are also able to loot or purchase a variety of equipment pieces; these include items such as gas masks, helmets, clothing, armour pieces and backpacks. Each of these will have a range of stats and bonuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/7d78739efbe1d00b64351501d09dbee0baa850da.png[/img]

[h2]Survival[/h2]
At its core Fargone is a survival game and as such a big focus has been placed on loot and making the loot immersive to use. Nearly all items in the game will have an animation attached to them (due to be expanded) so gone are the days of clicking instantly on an item and gaining the benefits immediately without visual feedback. You will need to find a safe spot to bandage yourself up or take an adrenaline shot. Sit by a campfire with other survivors and cook up some food to recover or retreat to your tent to end a hard day's work.
Adding to this is the dynamic buff & debuff system. Your character can gain a variety of effects based on actions and overall health. For instance not eating for long enough can cause sickness to arise which will lower your overall wellness rating and can make carrying equipment harder. Taken a big hit from a brute zombie? You might find yourself with a broken leg. These effects can be managed through the use of items such as bandages, splits etc... as well as maintaining your character's stats. There are many more effects and items that can be used but I will leave that to be discovered! The Barrens are a dangerous place and you must always be prepared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/6180c5ddcce5d0f221f722d18cc3ffd0bb47b826.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315919/66b27f17aaf3f6a067d36c36c4e80051f9103ea3.png[/img]

[h2]Progression[/h2]
This is a broad area but is still currently an early feature. Fargone is built to contain RPG elements. This feature has been slightly stripped back before launch to make sure only stable features make the release however a levelling and stats system is still present within the game. Gaining experience comes from just about any activity and levelling up will grant a skill point that can be used currently to level up one of several core skills. Internally a full talent system is being worked on and will be released very soon.
Besides levelling up, progression in a survival game also comes from building up your character's inventory and equipment and as such the world is built to accommodate that. The Hazzard zone is a prime example of this, although accessible at any time, the Hazzard zone contains a layer of toxic air that requires a degree of protection to enter safely, of course, you can down alcohol to try to make it through but this isn't the best choice! In addition to this, the Hazzard Zone also contains unique enemies that are much tougher. You will need to be well prepared to enter safely.

[h2]Progression and death[/h2]
Dying in Fargone works slightly differently from other survival games. You will not lose everything! You will wake up in the last place you slept however will most likely be looted while passed out. This means the items you may or may not lose is random each time so be careful! You will also find your overall wellness to be very low upon waking up and will need to nurse yourself back to health, you can't expect to get shot up and walk it off as if nothing happened!
[h2]
The future[/h2]
There is so much more to talk about currently in the game but I don't want to spoil every item and feature in one post! So I will end this by leaving some bullet points for future content that is planned and being worked on. I really hope you enjoy Fargone, this has been a passion project of mine for some time and I am so excited to see others finally jump in and try it out, [b]thank you![/b]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer coop (currently scheduled for Q2 '23 subject to change)
[*] Deeper AI system
[*] More activities such as fishing, farming and gambling opportunities
[*] End-game events such as bosses and survival modes (currently lightly in the game already)
[*] Settlements, claim a large base and recruit members of your current current faction to join your settlement
[*] Much more to be announced very soon!
[/list]
